title: A group contribution approach for predicting the environmental impacts of imidazolium-based ionic liquids
content:

DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00658A, Paper

The environmental impacts of imidazolium-based ionic liquids are estimated and predicted by combining life cycle assessment and a linear group contribution model.
